title: Graded coarse L1 EI17 200/250/300 W RF scan: Samuel-governed 100us input and solver preflight

stages.name: Check replay contract and install pinned host preparation libraries
command:
set -euo pipefail; bash -n experiments/Issue395_powered_chemistry_ladder/issue397_l1_power_scan_replay.sh; python3 -m venv .issue397-governed-venv; .issue397-governed-venv/bin/python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --quiet numpy==2.1.2 scipy==1.14.1; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=json.loads(Path('experiments/Issue395_powered_chemistry_ladder/issue397_final_l1_200_250_300w_power_scan_contract.json').read_text()); assert [v['target_power_W'] for v in p['cases']]==[200,250,300]; assert p['controls']['time_grid']['steps']==460; assert p['controls']['maxwell_child']['selected_abs_tol']==1e-11; assert p['controls']['wafer_faces']==27; print('ISSUE397_GOVERNED_PREFLIGHT_CONTRACT_PASS')
PY

stages.name: Generate exact L1 mesh and original EI17 RF chemistry inputs per power
command: set -euo pipefail; source .issue397-governed-venv/bin/activate; for power in 200 250 300; do bash experiments/Issue395_powered_chemistry_ladder/issue397_l1_power_scan_replay.sh prepare "$power"; done

stages.name: Compile exact-source PhysicsApp against immutable MOOSE build image
PhysicsApp --check-input for all three Maxwell abs1e-11 target cases
command: set -euo pipefail; for power in 200 250 300; do bash experiments/Issue395_powered_chemistry_ladder/issue397_l1_power_scan_replay.sh check "$power"; done
